$comment: Proposal only: independent operator selection pending. A-23 v0.3.3 remains adopted without modification.

ActivityData.description: Activity kind and benefit qualification are independent. Delivered/cited not proof of model used or was helped.

AssuranceData.description: Missing obligation is not HOLD. Empty visible hold list does not establish absence. Qualified-clear requires both qualified complete closures.

AttachmentData.description: Closed AEW attachment does not mean model conversation or remote process killed.

AttentionData.description: Priority and lane are owner-derived; agent text never sets urgency. Per root lineage aggregated flood limits.

CNIImpactScopeComparison.description: Exact CNI-issued comparability claim for the current impact field source, positively unaffected subset and bounded binding-coverage context. W0 checks internal consistency; W1 verifies the competent authentic source.

CapabilityData.description: Read-only IF-13/S-01 profile-capability projection; status strings are not self-qualifying; protected admission belongs to governing sources.

ClaimData.description: Research finding not engineering acceptance or scope authority.

Closure.description: Only governing owner can attest membership/absence. Scoped closure is never all-domain closure.

CoverageData.description: Coverage values are evidence-bound. Never infer qualified from schema or fixture pass.

Disclosure.description: Per effective principal+lineage/assignment/subject context. Scope_ref is opaque non-secret qualified token, not bearer authority.

FieldSource.description: Explicit authoritative owner source for mixed-origin consequential data fields.

HistoryAuditObservation.description: Auditor-origin bounded detection observation (not independent protection). No-findings always limited to attributable inspected set/period, with omissions and requested-scope incompleteness explicit. Null counters are withheld/unknown. Issuer qualification requires Layer B.

unaffected_scope_comparison.description: Mandatory CNI-qualified comparison for nonempty positive unaffected subset, including exact owner-issued binding coverage; null when no positive unaffected subset is asserted.

unaffected_subset_basis.description: CNI proof of exact disclosed unaffected subset; absence is not evidence of independence, especially when total affected universe is unknown.

assessment_binding.description: AEV-issued assessment work/scope/determination tuple, checked locally for exact consistency; actual issuance and authenticity are W1/W4.

JournalSelection.description: An independently scoped AEV-qualified JH-P01 eligible subset, not qualification of unrelated Knowledge records; absence of this producer is NOT a certified empty set.

KnowledgeData.description: Knowledge is a durable source-linked read projection. Case observation and Lesson interpretation remain distinct. No model-internal learning assertion.

Link.description: Only currently recipient-eligible, exact resolvable, reauthorized links may be emitted. Restricted/unknown targets have no Link object and no per-hidden placeholder.

PackageData.description: G1 result is independently qualified under adopted D-02 when available; no assumed historical main baseline.

PageInfo.description: Pagination end is scoped to authorized view, never a global absence claim. Cursors bound to effective recipient and entitlement.

Problem.description: No hidden fact IDs, reason classes or counts in error details. 404 used for both hidden and nonexistent.

Provenance.description: Narrative always inert. No author text as authoritative decision.

ReadContinuationVector.description: Inherited D-01 source-stamped ReadResult; semantic oracle requires external owner witnesses and recipient binding.

ReadHoldRecovery.description: Inherited D-01 source-stamped ReadResult; semantic oracle requires external owner witnesses and recipient binding.

ReadOwnerOperations.description: One operation per Resource. Only the outer page and collection_basis assert pagination and qualified recipient-scoped membership. Entries never assert independent closure.

ReadResult.description: Presence is explicit. List always has page; detail has null page. Failure of identity/disclosure is a Problem response, not a green empty set.

Renewal.description: Owner-issued renewal. Provider receipt timestamp never renews source conclusion.

Resource.description: Resource-specific data required and separately typed by resource_type. Owner_operation_index resources contain one operation entry, NOT a collection. Collection closure is outer only.

RunData.description: Distinct phase with typed provenance, stall and wake suspicion, possible external effect, HEB custody, R-01/IF-10 resource facts; simultaneous conditions are permitted. Schema strings never qualify an issuer or actor. No lifecycle effect.

non_model_effect_state.description: Separately attributable HEB non-model external/tool effect uncertainty; no whole-domain clear state

non_model_resource_exposure.description: Separately attributable R-01 resource/tool exposure outside the model-delivery accounting domain

remote_effect_domain.description: Model-provider effects across all IF-12 original model-delivery operations of this invocation, NEVER all non-model effects

remote_effect_state.description: Only remote effect across IF12_MODEL_DELIVERY_ONLY model-delivery calls; whole-invocation clearance remains NOT_ESTABLISHED

whole_invocation_effect_clearance.description: No selected all-effects issuer/universe; model-only qualification NEVER upgrades this

whole_invocation_resource_clearance.description: No selected all-resource accounting universe; model-only charge closure NEVER upgrades this

RunResourceSummary.description: Amounts may be omitted for confidentiality; null never means zero. Owner currentness and private parent scope still assessed independently.

accounting_domain.description: IF-10 accounting for model-delivery operations; not all other run resources or expenses

original_operation_ref.description: Operation attributed usage, or null only when independent complete zero-operation run closure qualifies NONE_QUALIFIED.

outstanding_exposure.description: Only outstanding exposure in IF10_MODEL_DELIVERY_ONLY model-delivery accounting domain, never whole-run expenses

SourceStamp.description: Source qualification is separate from transport uptime; exact stamp is owner-issued or qualification attributed, never frontend invented.

SubjectRef.description: Knowledge/coverage refs are auxiliary read projections, not new authority owners. Nullable disambiguators are explicitly null when inapplicable.

WorkData.description: Child completion never means qualified parent completion; no default all-work ready.

title: AEW D-01 v0.3.4 20-GET proposed exact-match successor
